$comment: Latest additions on the homepage. Newest first by date. An item appears only if every register id it depends on is public in this build, and never if it is the featured item. items.title: One goes, one stays
items.excerpt: How the outside defenders share the job: one goes forward to support, one stays to protect. A lesson from Issue 01, with the diagram that plays it.

items.title: Moving from 7v7 to 9v9
items.excerpt: Two more players, a bigger pitch and offside for the first time. Every rule that changes, checked against England Football.
